Technical appendix: Babel through E003

This appendix supports the E001/E002 and E003 posts. It records implementation, not a request to run it. All posts are drafts and unpublished. The E000 introduction will be written by the owner.

Data flow

Human browser input -> Game.handleTool -> normal tools -> simulation

E001/E002 Node driver -> imported normal tools -> separate simulation

E003 observation -> one OpenAI request -> function-call arguments
                -> local validation -> normal tool -> same in-memory simulation
                -> fixed time advancement -> saved observations/full maps

Saved evidence -> Python/Pillow rendering -> FFmpeg MP4

The first API utility is independent of the game. The browser game and Node test instances are independent of each other. The renderer never controls the game. E003 is the point where a model response first selects a game action.

Timestamped launcher output preserves runner, launcher, and protocol records, plus a game source diff where applicable. The diff captures tracked unstaged changes. It is not a complete workspace backup. E001’s first two runs predate automatic source capture. Its final original run includes source snapshots and the patch.

Build and test commands

Working directory for game installation and build: C:\Babel\micropolisJS. The install used a bundled package manager to supply pinned npm. Production build:

node .\node_modules\webpack-cli\bin\cli.js --mode production

Static server, using the bundled Python runtime:

& $babelPython -m http.server 5173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory C:\Babel\micropolisJS\dist

From C:\Babel, the recorded experiment and test entry points are:

node .\scripts\run-game-experiment.cjs
node .\scripts\run-settlement-experiment.cjs
node .\scripts\run-settlement-experiment.cjs --traffic-diagnostic
node .\micropolisJS\node_modules\jest\bin\jest.js --config .\scripts\upstream-tests.config.cjs --runInBand
node .\scripts\run-llm-repair.cjs

The final command defaults to local-only E003 preflight. It is not the paid live launcher. The completed live directory refuses another paid attempt. These commands are references. They were not rerun to assemble the writer handoff.

The Node harness uses Webpack with Node target, resolves .js and .ts imports, uses the game’s TypeScript loader and config, and writes a CommonJS bundle under .cache/babel-build/. The game’s TypeScript config uses ES5 target, CommonJS module compilation, allowJs, and strict checks.

E001 and E002 test children have 30-second execution timeouts. E003 has 30 seconds for local preflight and 45 seconds for the live child, with its own 30-second HTTP deadline. Compilation sits outside those child execution timeouts.

Exact repairs

Map restoration reconstructs tiles instead of using a setter that can preserve stale flags:

var map = saveData.map;
this._data = map.map(function(entry) {
  return new Tile(entry.value & BIT_MASK, entry.value & ALLBITS);
});
this.bounds = Bounds.fromOrigin(this.width, this.height);

BIT_MASK = 0x03FF extracts the tile ID. ALLBITS = 0xFC00 extracts six status flags.

The two census calls supply the simulation’s budget:

this._census.take10Census(this.budget);
this._census.take120Census(this.budget);

The traffic corrections:

var drivePos = new Position(startPos.x, startPos.y);
drivePos = Position.move(drivePos, dir);
this._stack.push(new Position(drivePos.x, drivePos.y));

No construction cost, growth probability, reward, or route-length rule was tuned to improve a score.

E003 request

The request below is copied from the saved live request. It contains no credential header. The input field is a JSON-encoded city report. It is included verbatim so readers can inspect the actual task and observation, not a retrospectively improved prompt.

{
  "model": "gpt-6-luna",
  "reasoning": { "effort": "none" },
  "max_output_tokens": 256,
  "service_tier": "default",
  "store": false,
  "instructions": "You operate a Micropolis city. Restore electrical supply to the existing zones with one legal action costing at most $50 game money. Inspect the supplied map and report. Select the best single action yourself. Return city_action with a brief visible explanation of at most 30 words. Do not request more data. For wait use x=0,y=0. A tool call is a proposal; the controller checks game legality. You cannot run arbitrary code.",

Cost basis

Estimated USD = ((input − cached) × 0.10 + cached × 0.01 + output × 0.50) / 1,000,000.

  • Preparation: (14 × 0.10 + 9 × 0.50) / 1,000,000 = 0.0000059
  • E003: (956 × 0.10 + 50 × 0.50) / 1,000,000 = 0.0001206
  • Recorded total estimate: 0.0001265

This is a dated basis, checked October 25 and 26, 2026. Do not assume current prices at publication. Model documentation source: GPT-6 Luna model documentation. Function-call design source: OpenAI function-calling guide.

Media notes

  • E002 video: 1280 × 720, 20 fps, H.264, 1,185 frames, 59.25 seconds, silent. Retrospective fixed-script reconstruction. Monthly measurements appear as a chart. Monthly map images were not invented.
  • E003 video: 1280 × 720, 20 fps, H.264, 940 frames, 47 seconds, silent. Actual saved state sequence and returned command. An earlier 55-second draft wrongly included warm-up states after the action. Use the 47-second version.
  • Both videos use upstream MicropolisJS tile artwork. License files were copied with the delivered media. Inspect those licenses before publishing assets.
  • Rendering used Python/Pillow and local FFmpeg 4.0.2 with libx264. No media packages were installed.

Claims to keep, and claims to avoid

Safe, with qualifications: the model API connection works; Babel places constructions with normal rules and costs on tested tools and sites; the repaired engine develops a scripted settlement in fixed small layouts; traffic works in the tested repaired paths; saved fields restored in E001; the first hosted model game command reached the game; that action was legal and executed correctly but failed to restore power; recorded project API spending was very small.

Do not claim: the LLM built or managed the E001/E002 cities; a balanced, profitable, self-sustaining AI city manager exists; E003 repaired power or succeeded on a later retry; the known scripted repair was the model’s choice; all upstream tests pass; a single failed model choice proves a particular prompt, map, or model weakness; a game task validates real-company management; the videos are original live screen recordings.
